totp_hint: The 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or a recovery code.
login_resent: If this address has an account waiting, a new link is on its way.
register_sent: Check your inbox: a link confirms your address and opens your account.
register_closed: This instance doesn't take new accounts.
register_login: Already have an account? Log in
reset_ask: Enter your email: if it has an account, a link to choose a new password is on its way.
reset_sent: If this address has an account, the link is on its way.
reset_done: Your password is changed: log in with it.
invite_text: Choose a password for your new account. If you already have one, it's ignored: you just join.
invite_joined: You joined: log in to see it.
setup_text: The first account is the instance's admin. The first storage holds the files: a folder on the server, or an S3 bucket. Credentials are paths to files on the server, never values.
setup_organization_hint: Its name, as people will see it.
setup_path_style: Path-style URLs (what self-hosted S3 servers usually need)
error_unsupported_server: This server doesn't speak this app's API (v1). Update one of them.
error_network: The server can't be reached. Check your connection.
error_email_not_verified: Your email address isn't confirmed yet: open the link we sent.
error_registration_closed: This instance doesn't take new accounts.
error_email_unavailable: This instance can't send emails yet: ask its admin.
error_invalid_token: This link is invalid or expired.
error_invalid_setup: Some of these values aren't valid: {message}
error_invalid_setup_token: The setup link is wrong: use the one the server printed in its logs.
error_already_set_up: This instance is set up already.
error_rate_limited: Too many attempts: wait a moment and try again.
error_unknown_identity: No account matches this login: ask for an invitation, or link it from your account.
error_identity_taken: This login is linked to another account already.
error_oidc_expired: The login took too long: try again.
error_oidc_refused: The login provider refused the login.
error_unknown_provider: This login provider isn't configured anymore.
